state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `a-refused-cast-also-reports-the-mixed-it-leaves` is closed. The parser gives back PHP's `(T)expr` as `ExprKind::Conversion { legacy: true }` after it reports `E0225`. `infer_conversion` in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/operators.rs` types a legacy conversion as `T` and runs none of the conversion's own checks. So `return $total + (int)$each;` in an `: int` method reports `E0225` alone, and `tests/conformance/reject/a-refused-cast-in-a-sum-reports-one-error.nvst` pins that. The semantic-token walker in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/semantic.rs` colours nothing inside a legacy conversion (`rule:ide/rejected-syntax-gets-no-colour`).

A `decimal` *property* default is still refused (`E0472`), because `nvs_runtime::FieldDefault` has no `decimal` recipe. The module doc of `crates/nvs-types/src/defaults.rs` says so.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes, so `startsWith("e\u{301}", "e")` is `true`. Whether they join the search family is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 27 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
